phrase.zh: 让模型先迎风，再让飞机上天。
phrase.en: Let a model meet the wind before an aircraft flies.

visual.zh: 机翼形状置于规整的气流线间，以实验空间表现看不见的空气作用。线的间距不代表可测的升力或阻力。
visual.en: A wing form sits within ordered airflow lines, staging invisible aerodynamic forces. Line spacing does not encode measured lift or drag.

background.zh: 风洞让气流经过模型，使研究者能测量形状受到的空气动力。莱特兄弟在 1901 年进行了一系列风洞测试，测量不同机翼模型的升力与阻力，为后来的飞机设计提供数据。
background.en: A wind tunnel sends air past a model so researchers can measure aerodynamic forces. In 1901 the Wright brothers tested many wing models for lift and drag, gathering data for later aircraft design.
